claim: Screen 48/60, LP repair 48/60, native plus proof 48/60 all-repeat on-time targets.
assumptions: Four fresh seed blocks, synthetic families, three rotated repeats; independently evaluated LP bound and 2e-6 feasible primal; per-policy development tuning.
falsifier: At least two additional all-repeat hits and positive lower interval endpoints against both comparators, with valid witnesses.

claim: 132/180 screen trials met the target after the outer LP alone; 132/180 for the equally screened LP repair arm.
assumptions: Both share an early-stop test. Count trial-level logs.
falsifier: A purported outer-only success has native or repair involvement or lacks an on-time certified target.

status: audited numerical primal and exact lower
claim: 2319 primal witnesses and 720 multiplier evaluations replayed; raw physical acceptance agrees with independent evaluation.
assumptions: Binary64 coefficients as exact rationals for lower; numerical engineering feasibility in original coordinates.
falsifier: A stored accepted primal violates model tolerance or an unrestricted dual certificate overstates the minimum feasible objective.

claim: Full-budget native numerical MIP target in 51/60 cases; all-repeat post hoc common-bound comparator 48/60.
assumptions: The native-only diagnostic uses no on-clock independent proof. Retrospective common LP bound may come from another policy.
falsifier: A named reported numerical or retrospective hit lacks a valid incumbent or the advertised separately sourced bound.

claim: 78/900 complete calls returned beyond two seconds.
assumptions: Measured monotonic shared-host time; on-time event and full synchronous return are different.
falsifier: Recomputed recorded complete-trial times yield other counts or reveal a late event given on-time credit.

claim: All 12 admissible small raw LP cases among 20 specified cells yielded full original-model rational feasible schedules with certified target gaps.
assumptions: Repeat zero, 4x8 cases only, fixed-mode simplex basis reconstructed over the stored binary64 coefficient model, outside the deadline.
falsifier: An original unrestricted row, box or integer fails exactly, or the independent unrestricted lower fails to give the target.

claim: The maximum violated-row fraction is the minimum feasible anchor weight on the chosen segment. The reconstructed point satisfies the convex base, all affine equalities and all listed inequality rows.
assumptions: Both endpoints in convex continuous slice and obey equalities. Anchor satisfies every row.
falsifier: Construct a permitted smaller feasible weight on that ray, a failed row at the proposed weight, or identify a mismatch in the model assumptions.

claim: A violated row with zero anchor margin forces return to the anchor. The affine objective change is exactly the selected weight times the anchor-to-candidate cost difference.
assumptions: Finite rows, affine cost and validated feasible anchor in the same mode.
falsifier: Exhibit an eligible zero-slack violation with feasible weight below 1 or an affine cost failing the displayed identity.

claim: For the Lipschitz objective the positive repair loss is at most L D δbar/(δbar+σ) under the stated common margins.
assumptions: Lipschitz on convex base, positive slack floor on violated rows, finite violation and displacement caps.
falsifier: A witness satisfying the full margin, norm and cost assumptions exceeds the cap.

claim: A box support bounds a signed affine projection error uniformly, and a certified candidate lift composes with the W04 regret bound.
assumptions: Projection returns a reduced feasible point for every full feasible point. Representation difference is affine in bounded coordinates. Candidate has reduced ε guarantee.
falsifier: Violate the computed upper support while preserving the range hypotheses, or show projection fails to enter the actual reduced type.

claim: A checked right inverse on the measured residual repairs affine equalities. Mixing alone preserves a nonzero residual until the anchor endpoint.
assumptions: Residual-compatible correction, all side constraints and objective rechecked.
falsifier: Test actual original equalities and find a residual after an exact checked correction.

status: Lean theorem under directional row model
claim: A single-slot fixed-mode adjustment of magnitude q exactly repairs terminal energy iff its forced magnitude satisfies every positive-slope row headroom bound and its directed sign is admissible.
assumptions: Correct energy gain, nonzero κ, represented original constraints (including equalities), initial nonterminal row slacks nonnegative.
falsifier: Independent SOC and coupling replay rejects a certified slot or accepts a directional repair deemed impossible at that exact target.

claim: Arbitrarily small violation can induce a full unit of repair cost with a boundary anchor. Failure of all single-slot repairs cannot prove whole-model infeasibility.
assumptions: Chosen ray and fixed-mode direction set. Mathematical stress inputs rather than a population sample.
falsifier: Invalidate the explicit points, costs or two-slot feasible witness.

claim: 3616 rational residual systems and 21497 fractional feasibility tests matched the ray formulas. All 960 signed slot queries agreed with exact physical reconstruction, including 386 declines.
assumptions: Specific rational pools, three periods and fixture constraints. No general success rate.
falsifier: Independent exact enumeration gives a classification or denominator disagreement.

claim: A midpoint of two common-slice feasible anchors reduces the necessary mixing weight to 2/3 in an instance where each individual ray requires weight 1.
assumptions: Two specified boundary anchors, two inequalities and affine cost.
falsifier: Either input anchor permits a lower weight, or mixed anchor fails to produce the stated point.

claim: Published polyhedral radial clipping from an interior reference gives the same segment endpoint under positive margins. Geometric novelty is not established.
assumptions: Comparison of formulas in the cited original RAYEN v1 section IV-A and the W05 row formula.
falsifier: The published outward step violates the row-ratio identity after converting q = 1 − λ.

claim: Pinned Lean rebuilt W04 AIPC, checked 40 new theorem declarations and rejected seven deliberately false examples.
assumptions: Prebuilt dependency cache, checked source commits, explicit axiom inventory. No certified floating-point or plant implementation.
falsifier: A matched clean rebuild fails, accepts a false example or introduces an undeclared axiom.

claim: The separately implemented verifier reproduced raw and repaired points, supports, weight and cost bounds, and regret intervals for all 25 primary successes and seven diagnostic repairs. A one-unit inflation of the archived uniform beta failed the check.
assumptions: Exact fixed-mode rational models, recorded reduced solutions and a prebuilt NumPy environment. Seven failed primary anchors retained.
falsifier: Any recovered raw point, support, constant or interval differs from the records in exact arithmetic or the altered bound is accepted.

claim: Seven of 32 original proposed anchors violated a reserve-energy floor. Every one of the remaining 25 yielded an exactly validated lift. Thirteen lifts reverted fully to the anchor.
assumptions: Eight seed blocks, four regimes, three-device fixed-mode eight-hour models. Each raw candidate violated at least one inequality.
falsifier: Independent row reconstruction changes anchor eligibility, segment feasibility or the number of full reversions.

claim: Zero of 25 qualified primary lifts certified 0.1% by candidate, uniform or direct full-reference gap. The exact feasible full-reference points also prove actual regret exceeded the target on every eligible case. The movement-matched LP was strictly cheaper on 25/25.
assumptions: Synthetic affine cost after removing a constant. Scale 0.001 times max(1,abs(full feasible reference)). Unrestricted across continuous variables within given modes only.
falsifier: Independent support or cost arithmetic crosses the threshold; a repair exceeds the segment movement budget or fails original rows.

claim: Median box alpha was 2560; affine candidate beta 743.83; combined bound 3215.59; direct full-reference regret upper 592.89. Reduced optimum closed exactly in 25/25 and full optimum in 10/25.
assumptions: Medians across qualified cases; component medians need not sum to median of a sum. All cost values in synthetic units.
falsifier: Re-evaluation of the exact primal/dual witnesses invalidates an interval or the reported sample aggregate.

claim: Across 100 terminal perturbations, 34 had one-slot witnesses; another 59 were certified by multi-slot repair only; seven returned neither.
assumptions: Four revised targets per qualified case. A missing multi-slot witness or solver infeasibility status lacks an exact infeasibility ray.
falsifier: A claimed witness fails any subsequent SOC, adjacent ramp, box, terminal, reserve or other constraint.

claim: All seven failed primary proposals had replacements certified on the unchanged matrices, with median acquisition 22.87 ms. Six new lifts returned to the replacement anchor and zero reached the target.
assumptions: Seven separate secondary attempts. The original seven failures stay in the denominator. Same-machine LP timing.
falsifier: The remedy alters original plant data, violates a row, or changes the preserved primary outcomes.

claim: 1775 certified support queries reduced median alpha to 302.5 and the candidate bound to 694.08. Zero of 25 reached the target. Median support time was 837 ms versus about 10 ms for a full-reference LP.
assumptions: Same 25 primary eligible cases, new reduced polyhedra. Dual certificates bound supports on the original fixed-mode polytope.
falsifier: An exact support certificate is invalid or a changed reduced feasible set fails to contain a full feasible projection.

claim: Guided elimination reached the 10% paired speed gain on zero of four comparable networks against each alternative. The 1888-bus network contributed zero matched pairs.
assumptions: Five pinned typical PGLib cases, five rotated repeats, 12-second total evaluation gate. Relative matched-cost tolerance 1e-5.
falsifier: An eligible matched median ratio is at most 0.90 and meets the common hit-rate gate.

claim: All 125 terminal vectors were evaluated independently. Exactly 100 were valid and timely, all 25 invalid vectors came from 1888 RTE. All 100 one-MW corruption controls failed validation.
assumptions: Physical original coordinates, both branch ends, generation, angles, voltage, balances and original cost. Static local feasibility.
falsifier: A recomputed valid state, time gate, or corrupted state disagrees.

claim: All 25 first-repeat physical starts and pivot selections matched the independent reconstruction. For the four common-start arms the greatest lift discrepancy was below 2.28e-10; the 1888-bus start violated generator limits by about 8773 in native units.
assumptions: Input start is reconstructed before any IPOPT bound push. The separate full DC start follows its own rule.
falsifier: A different starting tuple or selection under the frozen tie rules changes the matched comparison.

claim: Guided elimination decreased symbolic added fill on 73 and 200 buses and increased it on 24, 500 and 1888. The initial regularized condition estimate approximately doubled on 200 buses.
assumptions: W04 regularized KKT proxy and reverse Cuthill–McKee ordering; backend uses its own numerical pivots.
falsifier: A reconstructed sparsity pattern or comparable regularized calculation gives a different sign.

claim: 23/25 extended 60-second profiles qualified. At 1888 buses full DC, matched full and degree qualified; all and guided failed. Guided peak factors had 20476919 entries, full matched 5657717, degree 1433580.
assumptions: One run per cell, changed verbosity and budget, backend-specific numeric counters. Primary 12-second trials remain separate.
falsifier: Native factor entry logs or recomputed validation show a different result.

claim: Directed path inequalities prove absolute angle boxes redundant on 24, 73 and 200 buses. They leave 88 and 409 buses unresolved on 500 and 1888.
assumptions: Decimal active-branch bounds interpreted exactly with the selected reference angle. Inconclusive is not proof of an excluded AC feasible point.
falsifier: A shorter-path or path-direction counterexample invalidates a redundancy certificate.

claim: Spare-capacity filling won at H3/H6/H12. Development chose the same rule for the broader H12 information class, tied with the H6 nested-fill control.
assumptions: Selected comparator within prespecified finite W04-development class.
falsifier: Independent reconstruction under the frozen criterion selects a different rule or identifies a lower-shedding eligible H12 comparator.

claim: H6 learned continuation shed 8.054 more MWh/day than the selected rule on 60 new latent days (95% day-bootstrap interval +6.039 to +10.258).
assumptions: One pulse-generator panel, three equally weighted variants/seed, matched eligibility and hard constraints. One-sided 97.5% upper gate < −0.1.
falsifier: A matched reanalysis reverses the contrast or its scoring gate.

claim: H12 learned continuation shed 21.225 more MWh/day than the selected equal-information comparator (+18.254 to +24.259). All 60 latent-day means were worse.
assumptions: Best rule tied with nested fill on development. Preselected two-test family; descriptive paired percentile interval.
falsifier: Paired day-horizon comparison under the recorded forecasts reaches the frozen gain criterion.

claim: Upper one-sided bounds on excess CVaR90 shedding were +17.415 and +28.693 MWh/day at H6 and H12. Both exceed the +5 margin.
assumptions: Risk uses the worst ceil(0.1×60) equally weighted latent-day means per arm. This is a tail-risk proxy.
falsifier: Recomputed paired tail-risk upper bound falls below margin and all other safety and availability conditions pass.

claim: On the fresh primary panel the W04 H6 target reduced shedding by 4.386 MWh/day against its original H6 rule. The W05 H6 learned target improved on W04 but lost to tuned fill.
assumptions: W04 objective order and physical set. One native LP basis reused across lex objectives; W04 first-action check is finite.
falsifier: Fixed-comparator matched outcome no longer favors W04 at H6, or the representative first-action regression differs.

claim: A separate long-peak generator yielded +10.883 and +15.445 MWh/day excess shedding for learned H6 and H12.
assumptions: 24 separate latent seeds, each with three regimes. Same research group, site and validation model.
falsifier: A paired seed analysis of the alternative panel reverses the direction.

claim: Compute-matched adaptive selection reduced shedding 6.995 MWh/day against paying for both solves and always executing H12 on the main panel.
assumptions: Same H12 information, paid H6 and H12 calls, fixed online rule, no timing fallback; distinct resource cost from single-horizon solve.
falsifier: Identical input/compute re-evaluation gives no advantage or reveals later observations in the switch.

claim: Main-panel issued lead-6-to-11 load MAE was 5.896 versus 18.101 MW flat, yet learned H12 shed +11.005 MWh/day with the issued tail. On the alternative the interval includes zero.
assumptions: Hold last H6 load fixed versus actual issued tail; overlapping outcomes. No general ordering of information sets.
falsifier: Recalculation on the same targets changes MAE rank or the paired service effect.

claim: 5,040 trajectories, 120,960 hourly actions checked, zero errors/fallbacks, largest physical residual below 2e−13; all 5,040 controlled-clock replays returned identical first-action sequences.
assumptions: 20 arms, 84 latent seeds each under 3 regimes. Known outage reserve lost is logged separately. Same machine, all recorded timeout signals false.
falsifier: Recomputed constraint failure, a missing record, a changed action or accepted model corruption.

claim: Illustrative flat-price/wear/terminal-stock case yields H6-minus-fill net change +1517.31 − 8.054v USD/day; break-even v = 188.39 USD per served flexible MWh.
assumptions: Grid $50/MWh, movement $10/MWh, ending SOC $50/MWh, computing $0.20/worker-hour, zero differential fixed expense. One-hour intervals, linear service value and acceptance of unequal risk.
falsifier: Alternative valuation or re-evaluation of hourly costs changes the sign or break-even case. No realized revenue was measured.

claim: Nominal fill has exact-model mean full-information improvement ceiling 0.04425028 MWh/day on 180 primary scenario-days; 148 equal the exact LP lower bound. The 0.1 mean threshold is outside the attainable range on those stored days.
assumptions: Exact rational interpretation of stored binary64 model; clairvoyant LP relaxation; exact feasible fill. Logged fill differs from rational witness by <5.69e−14 per component. No stochastic population bound.
falsifier: Any invalid primal/dual sign, row or arithmetic check; mean exact gap ≥ 0.1; or changed model conditions.

claim: 17 native payloads reproduce the 212600-byte 1570-line v0.4 source. All internal keys resolve and the manuscript compiles to 66 pages.
assumptions: Join the payloads by one LF. Bibliography identity is checked separately.
falsifier: Re-export yields a different byte sequence; unstable auxiliary references; an unresolved bibliography or internal label key.

claim: Of 46 references, 36 public works were identified, nine internal artifacts matched content or an archive inspection, and one private ZIP was identified from metadata.
assumptions: Access mode and edition qualifications are row-specific. An author-site record is not full verification of a scientific inference.
falsifier: A cited original or edition contradicts its ledger row or a metadata-only archive was treated as inspected.

claim: The v0.3 source retained its recorded digest; the exact prior W04 ZIP supplies the dependency snapshot.
assumptions: Original sources read locally. Time-local provenance and SHA-256 capture; no independent timestamping service.
falsifier: A listed dependency or original has a different fingerprint.

claim: No independent-machine or field replication was performed. E uses an additional synthetic generator and within-host deterministic replay; A and C report wall-clock outcomes on one shared host.
assumptions: No deployment, physical actuation, independent external review, commercial value or global AC proof is established by these runs.
falsifier: Independent production or replication evidence with matched information, controls and physical constraints changes the scope.
